changed_factors: Dense TensorFlow-v1 Adam law with independent G/D moments and epsilon
Least-squares fake/real/G labels [-1,1,1], including the joint encoder stream
Constant whole-update rates; no inferred historical decay or additional critic penalty
Learned prior has explicit beta (0,.999), epsilon 1e-8 and multiplier 2; task owns its law
mechanism_rationale: Optimizer/loss transfer from an unbound historical config; architecture, auxiliary AlphaGAN eloss and original trained outcome are outside scope. Constant LR is explicit. No qualification or default adoption.
